summary: Completed backend API regression + broad UI/integration testing on public URL. Core resident, admin, owner workflows are functional including society creation, registration rules, reporting/consolidation, #1042 demo checks, admin actions, analytics/map/notifications, and tenant/role authorization matrix.
action_items: Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with maintained non-demo test accounts for future agents.
Optional: add explicit post-logout redirect hint/button to /enter to reduce user friction from landing redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth test credential registry file exists but is empty; this slows deterministic auth regression and violates the intended auth testing process.
No critical security leak found in tested read endpoints (password_hash/token_hash absent in tested responses).
seed_data_creation: Created isolated UI/API test societies during run: TU-930210, TO-574238; created additional test reports/cases in those societies and admin credentials for workflow validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite added and passing (11/11) against public endpoint. UI validated landing responsive (desktop, 390, 375; no horizontal overflow), create/enter/register paths, registration_open block/unblock, resident report clustering behavior (related grouped, nonrelated separate), demo #1042 expected counts (50/37/9), evidence modal, admin action chain (review/request_info/escalate/assign/verify/status/update), notifications mark-read, analytics, map pin navigation, admin restriction from initial-admin routes. Avoid mutating demo #1042 further unless restoring state.
rca of the issue: No blocking functional defects found in executed scope. Earlier Playwright failures were test-script flow issues (expecting login form immediately after logout while app redirects to landing), not product defects.
mocked_api_notice: MOCKED: Deterministic simulated AI analysis, weather/AQI/traffic providers, schematic map simulation, and synthetic Green Valley demo records/evidence. REAL: auth, persistence, reporting workflows, admin actions, and object storage evidence upload/download permissions.
